meta.name: Disciplined Entrepreneurship (MIT Orbit / DE Toolbox)
meta.refresh_cadence: quarterly — product-only benchmark, low expected rate of change; not worth a tighter cadence given thin public footprint

snapshot.one_liner: Ecosystem built around Bill Aulet's (MIT Martin Trust Center) 'Disciplined Entrepreneurship: 24 Steps to a Successful Startup' methodology: books, the DE Toolbox (dashboards/tools, course-integration), MIT's Orbit platform (resource hub/community), and JetPack (a generative-AI assistant trained on the 24-step framework, launched 2024).
snapshot.why_they_compete: High similarity on structured curriculum plus tools plus course-embedding; arguably the closest match to Altitut's web app minus gamification, per COMPETITORS.md (#7 of 10).

positioning.value_prop: JetPack is pitched as 'like having five or ten MIT undergraduates' instantly researching market segments, beachhead markets, business model, and pricing per the 24-step framework — an AI-accelerated version of a proven academic methodology.
positioning.differentiation: Direct MIT/Bill Aulet academic pedigree and a named, structured 24-step methodology as the organizing spine of every tool.

1_identity.audience_icp: Startup founders; entrepreneurship educators/courses (DE Toolbox is course-embeddable with student progress tracking/mentor feedback); MIT students primarily via Orbit; also accelerators, incubators, investors.

similarity_to_us.rationale: Arguably the closest structured-curriculum-plus-tools-plus-course-embedding match to Altitut's web app, minus a game layer; MIT-specific reach limits direct audience overlap. Directional judgment, not a scoring model.

highlight_features.feature: JetPack (AI assistant trained on the 24-step framework)
highlight_features.why_pushed: The newest, most differentiated feature — an AI research assistant mapped directly to the methodology's steps.

highlight_features.feature: DE Toolbox dashboards (team/mentor tracking, course integration)

highlight_features.why_pushed: Broader-reach entry point beyond the paid toolbox.

most_attractive_features.why_it_lands: 'Like having 5-10 MIT undergrads' is a vivid, concrete value proposition that directly translates methodology into automated research output.
